_comment: The palette every sprite in fragr is quantised to, referenced by
It is grouped by what each ramp is for, because the factions are told
apart by colour before they are told apart by shape. See docs/ART-COLOR.md
for the rule of grey: most of the world sits in the neutral ramps so that
the small amount of rust orange and alert red carries all the meaning.
Each ramp is four steps or fewer. A sprite at this size cannot spend more
than four values on one material without the steps becoming invisible.
